scientific_integrity: Analytic proof plus finite exact-rational checks; not independently validated; historical priority provisional.
scientific_limitations: One initial uniform infection, irreversible transmission, one distinct-time encounter per edge, homogeneous independent per-contact success probability.
Only connected diameter-three double-star trees with positive leaf counts on both hubs.
Variance is over conditional expected outbreak across uniformly randomized calendars, not total realized-outbreak variance.
An earlier equivalent edge-ordering enumeration could exist beyond inspected literature.
title: Exact schedule risk and optimal contact order on two-hub epidemic trees
